snippet.title: Clown House: Lunacy (Squeaky Teaser)
snippet.description:
We have exciting news from our upcoming horror game, formerly titled as "Clown House 2".

First, we have a new name: Clown House: Lunacy. Rather than a direct sequel, we are executing the ideas from our past experimental game.

While our focus is single-player, co-op multiplay is also supported for 2 players.

Steam store page will be live in January 2026. We plan the Steam early-access release in 2027. Windows and macOS are natively supported.

We will be sharing more content and details in our social media accounts and new Discord server. Come join the Clown House! https://linktr.ee/clownhousethegame
